question: text-based video editing premiere pro
response_text:
As a US-based content creator looking to leverage text-based video editing alongside or as an alternative to Adobe Premiere Pro, you are operating in one of the fastest-growing sectors of post-production. Text-based editing allows creators to edit video timelines simply by cutting, copying, and pasting text transcripts, drastically reducing rough-cut times.
